Calls - Regular Calling Offer Users.description: High-engagement Calls customers — buy calling bundles habitually and respond to offers. The Calls flagship segment.
Calls - Regular Calling Offer Users.tone_notes: Warm and appreciative. Treat them as loyal regulars. Light incentive, emphasize the upgrade path to higher-value calling bundles.

Calls - Infrequent Casual Users.description: Low-volume Calls buyers — small Recharge / Calling Offer purchases, no habit yet.
Calls - Infrequent Casual Users.tone_notes: Friendly and educational. Frame calling bundles as a trial. Heavier offer if they've been quiet for a while.

eSIM - High-Value Bundle Subscribers.description: Top-tier eSIM customers — highest spend, full eSIM / EU / regional bundle buyers.
eSIM - High-Value Bundle Subscribers.tone_notes: Premium and value-forward. Acknowledge their travel history. Don't over-discount — they buy for quality and coverage.

eSIM - High-Velocity Light Spenders.description: Frequent eSIM buyers but cheap purchases — many small Local eSIM transactions. Strong bundle-upgrade candidates.
eSIM - High-Velocity Light Spenders.tone_notes: Casual upsell tone. Acknowledge the frequent use, suggest a Full eSIM or regional bundle as the better-value option.

eSIM - Dormant Local Data Users.description: One-time, low-spend eSIM customers (mostly Local eSIM) who have not returned. The largest churn-risk eSIM segment.
eSIM - Dormant Local Data Users.tone_notes: Empathetic re-engagement. Don't be salesy — acknowledge the gap. Substantial offer to overcome inertia.

Virtual - High-Spend Power Users.description: Top-tier Virtual Number customers — highest spend and purchase volume. Strong business / enterprise signal.
Virtual - High-Spend Power Users.tone_notes: Professional and pitch-aware. Emphasize reliability, dedicated numbers, and the EU/business plan upgrade path.

Virtual - Mid-Tier Phone Plan Holders.description: Moderate-spend Virtual Number customers — solid Local Calling Plan / Phone Number buyers. Natural EU bundle / add-on upsell.
Virtual - Mid-Tier Phone Plan Holders.tone_notes: Helpful and benefit-led. Position the EU Bundle or international add-on as the obvious next step. Medium incentive.

Virtual - Light Occasional Users.description: Low-spend, infrequent Virtual Number buyers — minimal Phone Number activity. Activation / reactivation candidates.
Virtual - Light Occasional Users.tone_notes: Welcoming, low-pressure. Lead with the use-case (a number that's easy to keep). Heavier offer if very dormant.

unknown.description: New or unclassified user — no behavioral data yet.
unknown.tone_notes: Friendly and discovery-focused. Ask about their use case or destination to guide them to the right product.
